lines: Future: A brand-new avenue! Exciting, isn't it?
Jacci: Welcome! The owner's just over here.
Owner: Just stopping by to see how my avenue's doing! Keep it up, manager.
Future: Invite visitors whose dreams you like, and recommend the shops they'll love!
Welcome to the manager's office. The manager's assistants are always here to help.
Owner: Hello there! Welcome to Join Avenue! Please, come and talk to me!
Welcome to the Battle Frontier! Five facilities and their Frontier Brains are waiting for you.
The way back to the Fight Area is down the stairs behind me.
Isn't the Battle Frontier something? I hear there are places like it far away, in other regions too.
I've trained my little guy as hard as we can go. We're going for a fifty-win streak... Right, Pikachu?
I've always loved see-through lifts like the one here. Ever since I was little! ...Well, mostly.
Shall I heal your Pokemon? ...Oh my, sorry! I'm not on duty today. I just came to watch the battles.
PIKACHU: ......
PICHU: Pichu! Pichu!
Tee hee! Everyone around here looks so weak! ...No, no, thinking like that is how you lose. I take it back!
Trust your Pokemon, and they'll find the move you need when it counts.
Look how tall the Battle Tower is! How many floors do you think it has?
I've been with Pokemon for forty-nine years. Or was it fifty? I've lost count!
I came here to sing my new song! ...But everyone's too busy battling to listen.
Don't be afraid of losing. Every loss teaches you something new!
In the Battle Hall it's one Pokemon at a time. Even my Magikarp gets its turn!
Win some, lose some. I just keep my float ring handy!
Seeing how much these Trainers care for their Pokemon makes me want to try harder too.
I used to love fishing. Now all I can think about is the Battle Frontier!
Want to get stronger? Learn your types, and learn your moves!
At the Battle Factory you battle with borrowed Pokemon. That's a real test of skill!
Bragging after a win? Not me. A good Trainer stays humble.
Pokemon help us work, travel and play. They're the best friends there are.
Each facility here has a Frontier Brain. Win enough battles in a row and they'll come out to face you!
Someone told me strong and weak are two sides of one coin. I still don't get it!
My favourite is the Battle Castle. The butler there is soooo polite!
I came to the Frontier looking for work. I can cook, I can clean... and I can battle!
The best thing about being a Trainer? All the friends you make along the way!
Pokemon learn something from every battle, just like we learn something from every day.
Every battle tells a little story, dear. Ours brought us all the way out here!
